findings.title: Doc comment of parentOf does not match what it returns
findings.why: The comment says it returns the container and the last token, but the function returns only the parent container. The last token is taken separately by every caller.

findings.title: Random roundtrip test is not reproducible
findings.why: It uses Math.random without a seed. A failure on one run may not reproduce on the next, which makes it hard to debug.
